## Checklist (from `rules.md` Definition of Done)

- [ ] Works end to end (UI → API → DB where applicable)
- [ ] Input validated and errors handled
- [ ] Auth/ownership enforced (if it touches user data)
- [ ] Tested manually (Postman / browser)
- [ ] Automated tests added or updated
- [ ] No secrets or debug code committed
- [ ] Commit messages follow the convention (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, etc.)
- [ ] New env variables added to `.env.example`, env matrix, and platform dashboards
- [ ] README/docs updated if behaviour changed
- [ ] I can explain what every changed line does
